name: dated-bookings
description: One entity with a date field guarded by a before-hook reject over that date. It exists so the engine-sensitive API suite can prove a date guard fires on every engine: a date column reaches the hook as the engine's own date shape, and a comparison the interpreter cannot normalise answers false, so the reject would never fire (issue #317).

bookings.description: A booking whose start day, once set, cannot be moved.

action.reject: A booking's start day cannot be moved. Cancel it and book again.
